sn35.53:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.53:1.3: Kathan nu kho bhante jānato katham passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti || || 4
sn35.53:2.1: Cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti || ||
sn35.53:2.2: Rūpe aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || ||
sn35.53:2.5: Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || || 5-8
sn35.53:2.10: Manam aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || ||
sn35.53:2.14: Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukham vā || tam pi aniccato jānato passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati || || 10
sn35.53:2.15: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti || || 3
